name: Nirmatrelvir and ritonavir
class: SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease inhibitor with CYP3A4 boosting
description: A SARS-CoV-2 main protease inhibitor co-packaged with ritonavir as a pharmacokinetic booster, approved for mild-to-moderate COVID-19 at high risk of progression. The ritonavir component is the source of an extensive drug interaction burden.

systems.note: Viral protease inhibition; the labelled antiviral indication.
Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor; transaminase elevation is labelled and interactions are extensive.
Dose reduction is labelled in moderate renal impairment.

monitors.why: Labelled transaminase elevation and an extensive CYP3A4 interaction burden.
Labelled dose reduction in renal impairment.
